newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent loses support on limited bullish news.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent loses support on limited bullish news.

text.p: August Brent crude futures fell in late trading on Wednesday as there was limited bullish news to support prices, SIMEX brokers said.
August Brent on SIMEX was last traded at $18.65 per barrel, 15 cents lower than London's closing level.
"Brent could be dragged lower due to weak product prices, especially gasoil" said a broker.
London had closed 29 cents higher at $18.80, on expectations of bullish American Petroleum Institute (API) figures.
But this was not enough to keep the Brent prices supported, brokers said.
August Brent was last traded at $18.55 per barrel, just four cents higher than London.
London gapped higher to leave chart-gap support between $18.24 and $18.27. It closed near the highs of the day which has encouraged some follow through buying, traders said.
NYMEX crudes were lightly traded during ACCESS in Asia, with just a handful of lots changing hands. August was last traded at $19.81, up one cent from New York.
